notes: Answers: date is the application date at the top (any common shape, printed mm/dd/yyyy); business_address the street line (a full address prints its street only; the ZIP has its own question); apartment_buildings_units 'buildings, units' (blank for a shop or restaurant); applicant_home_city_state_zip 'City, ST ZIP'. The applicant's signature is left for the applicant; Project Number and Processed By are for the office.
